notes.title: About the public document copies
paragraphs: These downloads preserve the complete page and slide sequences of the inspected originals. Public copies remove contact details, private advisor and mentor names, operational identifiers in screenshots, and document annotations or metadata. Neutral labels mark substantive privacy omissions.

Keystone is a joint presentation. The public copy retains Carlo Cancellieri’s name and omits a colleague’s name for privacy. The revised GeoID naming deck represents the two closely related source editions. These documents record the designs and claims of their original editions.

notes.title: MBA thesis: methodology and reading guide
paragraphs: Ethical AI Practices and ESG Integration: A Framework for Sustainability is Carlo Cancellieri’s May 2024 MBA dissertation at Neapolis University Pafos. It combines a literature review, a proposed AI Empowerment and Replacement Index (AERI), and a hypothetical simulation for CC&Co. with an initial workforce of 100. It contains no empirical workplace trial or validated causal estimate of AI’s effect on employment.

The original academic text is retained, including its numerical and terminology inconsistencies. The accompanying project page sets out the proposed formulas, limitations, and errata separately. Environmental score E stays constant in the simulation. The workforce and productivity inputs are assumptions.
Page references in the reading guide use physical PDF pages, starting with the cover as page 1. From the abstract onward, the printed body page number is four less than the physical page number.
